title: A New Voyage Round the World: Guam sailing canoes
version: Digitized transcription of the 1697 travel narrative, chapter 10
lineage: A later web transcription of Dampier’s observational account; the source records a specific seventeenth-century example, not the exact 1521 vessel.

passages.note: Paragraph beginning “The natives are very ingenious”: double-ended hull, stabilizing side float, shifting yard when reversing direction.
